cases.why: Kalshi is consulted first, so the backtest's own source stops pricing the picks Model B was trained for
the spread limit is never applied, so a preseason 0.15/0.79 quote becomes a price
a live, in-game price is taken as the pre-game market
ESPN's 0 for a missing price is read as a price, so a game with none gets a nonsense probability
a game with no price loses its reasons, so the page cannot say why there is none
Kalshi's NYK and GSW never match ESPN's NY and GS, so those clubs never get a fallback price
a price read after the start, an in-game price, is kept in the line history
